title: Towards Predicting Smoking Events for Just-in-time Interventions.
summary: In 28 participants observed in naturalistic settings, ECG/GPS machine-learning models detected and predicted smoking events with modest accuracy; the paper supports a limited proof-of-concept for individualized just-in-time prediction. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
